decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The removal of Condition 35 would not harm interests of acknowledged importance or impede the proper planning and regeneration of Hounslow Town Centre.  The proposal is therefore not considered to conflict with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), ENV-B.1.8 (Access and Facilities for People with Disabilities), ENV-B.1.9 (Safety and Security), ENV-T.1.2 (The Movement Implications of Development) ENV-T.2.1 (Pedestrian Access) ENV-T.2.2 (Pedestrian Safety and Security), and ENV-T.2.6 (Safety of Public Transport).
description: Removal of Condition 35 of planning permission 00616/F/P5 dated 31/07/2002 which requires Council approval of a walkway link between the Blenheim Centre and Hounslow Central Underground station before the large retail unit approved on 31 July 2002 is first opened
